doc.brief: Determines whether the spin button displays values outside the adjustment bounds.
doc.md:
Determines whether the spin button displays values outside the adjustment
bounds.

See [`SpinButton.set_update_policy()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.SpinButton#method:set_update_policy).

always.brief: When refreshing your `GtkSpinButton`, the value is always displayed
always.md:
When refreshing your `GtkSpinButton`, the value is
  always displayed

if_valid.brief: When refreshing your `GtkSpinButton`, the value is only displayed if it is valid within the bounds of the spin button's adjustment
if_valid.md:
When refreshing your `GtkSpinButton`, the value is
  only displayed if it is valid within the bounds of the spin button's
  adjustment
